title: Kitchen
note: Kitchen pack (tools/make_kitchen_assets.py). The size (dimensions_m) comes from the universal _base_dimensions schema.

kitchen_kind.label: Kind
kitchen_kind.note: What it is: appliance, cabinet (counters, islands, shelves), table, seating or accessory (cookware, small things).

finish.label: Finish
finish.note: The finish of this variant: stainless_steel, white, black, oak, maple, walnut or standard.

power_draw_w.label: Power draw (W)
power_draw_w.note: Watts drawn while it runs; 0 for anything that uses no electricity.
